definitions.explanation: officially recording or entering figures, especially financial amounts, in accounts or budgets

examples.japanese: {利益|りえき}を{計上|けいじょう}する。
{今期|こんき}は{赤字|あかじ}を{計上|けいじょう}した。
examples.english: We recorded a loss this fiscal period.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}に{新規|しんき}{費用|ひよう}を{計上|けいじょう}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to include new expenses in the budget.

examples.japanese: {特別|とくべつ}{損失|そんしつ}として{計上|けいじょう}された。
examples.english: It was recorded as a special loss.

notes:
{計上|けいじょう} is an accounting term meaning to record or enter figures in financial statements or budgets.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {計|けい} (measure, plan, calculate)
- {上|じょう} (on, above; to list)

USAGE:
- {計上|けいじょう}する (to record, to book - suru verb)
- 〜を〜として{計上|けいじょう}する (to record ~ as ~)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {利益|りえき}を{計上|けいじょう}する (to record profits)
- {損失|そんしつ}を{計上|けいじょう}する (to record losses)
- {売上|うりあげ}を{計上|けいじょう}する (to record sales)
- {費用|ひよう}を{計上|けいじょう}する (to record expenses)
- {引当金|ひきあてきん}を{計上|けいじょう}する (to record reserves)

ACCOUNTING CONTEXT:
- Used in financial reporting and budgeting
- Common in earnings announcements and financial statements
- {前倒|まえだお}し{計上|けいじょう} (advance booking)

RELATED TERMS:
- {記載|きさい} (entry, statement)
- {記録|きろく} (record, recording)
- {算入|さんにゅう} (inclusion in calculation)
- {充当|じゅうとう} (allocation, appropriation)
